title: Vendster: An Evaluation Arena to Investigate How Forecasting Tool Quality Affects LLM Agent Behaviors in Buyer-Vendor Negotiation
summary: Forecast-quality metrics do not predict simulated negotiation outcomes; controlled under-prediction improves target attainment only for the two closed LLMs. This is the result-bearing preprint version dated 2026-10-28; peer-review status is not established by the reviewed source.
ai_technology: Four LLM families act as buyers/vendors using model-generated or controlled synthetic forecasts; the study varies forecast bias and interval width.

evidence.tested: Forecast-quality metrics do not predict simulated negotiation outcomes; controlled under-prediction improves target attainment only for the two closed LLMs. The controlled bias/interval grid and observational forecast comparison use one M5-grounded simulated negotiation instance; no real sales or other elasticity is established.
evidence.unknown: not predict simulated negotiation outcomes; controlled under-prediction improves target attainment only for the two closed LLMs.
